specialReports.title: Corporate Capex Recovery Uncertain Post-Elections
specialReports.summary: Historical data reveals no guaranteed corporate investment surge after elections, with muted private sector confidence and volatile PSU spending patte
specialReports.bulletSummary:
• Corporate capex in FY23 stood at 14.8% of GDP, matching pre-pandemic levels but far below FY08 peak of 21.6%
  • Corporate savings recovered to 14.1% of GDP in FY23, nearly matching FY08 levels despite weak investments
  • Corporate sector transformed from net borrower of 7.7% of GDP in FY08 to marginal borrower of 0.7% in FY23
  • Post-election capex growth was strong in 2004 and 2009 but negligible in 2014 and 2019
  • PSU investments show high volatility, driving 2014 recovery but causing 2019 weakness
  • Private corporate capex growth remained stable at 11-13% across pre- and post-election periods in 2014 and 2019

specialReports.title: Corporate Capex Post-Elections
specialReports.summary: Corporate capex trends post-elections show mixed results, with potential for growth.
specialReports.bulletSummary:
• Corporate capex in FY23 was 14.8% of GDP, similar to pre-pandemic years but lower than FY08 peak.
  • Corporate savings have picked up to 14% of GDP since FY15, similar to FY08 levels.
  • Net borrowings of the corporate sector have decreased significantly, averaging 0.8% of GDP in recent years.
  • Investment recovery in the past has been supported by a wider CAD.
  • Historical data shows mixed results for corporate capex growth post-elections, with better growth in 2004 and 2009 compared to 2014 and 2019.
  • PSU investments exhibit greater volatility compared to private corporate sector investments.

specialReports.title: Public Capex Growth
specialReports.summary: Public capex is driving infrastructure growth.
specialReports.bulletSummary:
• Public capex is improving across the Center, states, and PSUs, boosting growth visibility in infrastructure, CVs, logistics, capital goods, cement demand, and metals.
  • FYTD26 state capex: States' capex grew 14.4% YoY in 9MFY26, with a significant 23.9% YoY surge in 3QFY26.
  • FY27 capex projections: States' capex projected at INR11.3t in FY27BE, reinforcing the state-led capex cycle.
  • FY27 Center + states + PSU capex: Combined public sector capex estimated at INR28.4t in FY27, equivalent to 7.1% of GDP, implying ~11% YoY growth.

specialReports.title: Market Trends and Stock Insights
specialReports.summary: Equity markets dipped in July'25 amid mixed earnings.
specialReports.bulletSummary:
• Equity markets dipped in July'25 after gaining for four consecutive months, weighed down by mixed earnings, FII outflows, and uncertainty around India-US trade deal and tariffs.
  • Nifty50 fell 2.9% (-749 points) in Jul'25, to close at 24,768.
  • Broader markets significantly underperformed with Nifty Midcap100 and Smallcap100 declining by 3.9% and 5.8% respectively.
  • 1QFY26 earnings have broadly been in line with 184 MOFSL Universe companies reporting a net profit growth of 7% YOY.
  • Global central banks maintained a cautious stance amid persistent inflation concerns and mixed economic signals.
  • The US Fed, ECB, BoJ, and BoE kept rates unchanged. RBI too held its policy rate steady, reiterating its focus on inflation control amid resilient domestic growth.
